title: [M2] Profile timing, registration and body/head synchronization
acceptance: - [x] Use pinned profile timing/reachability and ACT raw delays; diagnostic timing is explicitly labeled instead of silently substituted.
- [x] Respect offsets, registration and declared origin/head anchors, with player body/head synchronization where supported.
- [x] Provide deterministic stepping, play/loop/speed and action/view selection; unsupported attachment/timing behavior remains visible.
- [x] Version rendering/timing semantics so relevant changes can invalidate affected pre-build reviews.
